summary: Form I-864, “Affidavit of Support Under Section 213A of the INA”, is the contract in which a sponsor promises the U.S. Government to support an immigrant financially and shows enough income or assets to do so. The sponsor fills it in: usually the U.S. citizen or permanent resident who filed the family petition, plus a joint sponsor if that income is not enough.
